title: Renewal Ceiling Growth: Recent Clinical Information and Chronic Migraine
content:
On a member-filed renewal of a quantity limit authorization for an acute migraine drug under the Utilization Management Program, the renewal ceiling is the approved quantity on the authorization being renewed times a growth multiple, rounded to three decimal places. The growth multiple rests on the member's clinical information for the drug:

| Clinical information for the drug received within the last month | Most recent clinical information carries a chronic migraine diagnosis | Growth multiple |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.25 |
| Yes | No | 1.15 |
| No | Yes | 1.15 |
| No | No | no change under this rule |

- **Chronic migraine diagnosis** means ICD-10-CM G43.701, G43.709, G43.711 or G43.719 on the most recent clinical information received for the drug.
- **Within the last month** means received after the same day of the month one month before the filing date.

## Hypothetical figures (approved quantity on the authorization being renewed: 16)

- Clinical information received 10 days before filing, diagnosis G43.719: ceiling 16 times 1.25, that is 20.
- Clinical information received 10 days before filing, episodic migraine diagnosis: ceiling 16 times 1.15, that is 18.4.
- Last clinical information received five months before filing, diagnosis G43.701: ceiling 18.4.
